system: Decide one routing question for an H3 video request: are the attached still images actual first/last frames of the generated video, or content references redrawn into a new scene? Interpret the whole request semantically. Do not route from a keyword list. An actual opening frame selects i2va; an actual closing frame selects l2va; two opening/closing frames select fl2va. Identity, environment, style and storyboard references select ref2va. A character appearing in a requested scene is not an anchored frame. Caller-declared roles/provenance outrank ambiguous prose. A generic unstated subject role is not a declaration. For genuine ambiguity, make an explicit ref2va decision with low confidence and explain that soft reference conditioning does not guarantee an exact frame. Never invent observations about unread media. Return exactly the supplied JSON contract.

brief.intent: animate this photo: bring it to life with slow drifting motion

cards.summary: A dark, cinematic character reference sheet for one adult figure, featuring a rain-soaked nighttime HERO image plus FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK turnarounds and close-up details of the FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

subjects.descriptor: Adult with East Asian facial features, shaved-side hair gathered into a small back bun, and a visible scar through one eyebrow.
attributes: dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot or bun
black collared jacket with strap and buckle hardware
pose: HERO: standing in profile facing left, arms relaxed at sides
FRONT: facing forward, arms at sides
SIDE PROFILE: standing in left-facing profile
BACK: standing with back to camera

cards.environment: Rain-soaked rooftop or walkway at night with metal railings and distant city lights in the HERO panel; plain dark charcoal studio backdrop for the turnaround and detail panels.
cards.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting: cool blue-gray night ambience with warm amber bokeh highlights in the hero image, and soft directional studio light against dark backgrounds in the reference panels.
cards.framing: Vertical multi-panel character sheet: large full-body hero atop three full-body turnaround views and four close-up detail crops.
cards.style: Photorealistic cinematic concept-art character reference sheet with a dark neo-noir mood.
cards.characterisation: A dark, tactical-dressed adult character presented for design reference, with consistent hair, scar, and all-black clothing across multiple views.
